line.a_burza.text: Oh dear, there was a storm last night! The wind blew everybody's things all over the place.

line.a_pomoge.text: I'll help! I'll put the things in pairs.

line.a_kolor.text: A red cup and a red apple. Both are red, so they're a pair!

line.a_nie.text: Mole, they only have the same colour. But we don't use them for anything together.

line.a_razem.text: A pair is two things we use together. Look: a cup and a saucer.

line.a_filizanka.text: We put the cup on the saucer. They go together, even though they look different.

line.a_rozumiem.text: I see! A pair is things that go together because we use them together.

line.a_do_warsztatu.text: The wind blew the rest of the things into my workshop. Let's go!

line.b_rzeczy.text: So many things! We must join them into pairs.

line.b_polacz.text: Join the things that go together with your finger. Draw a line from one to the other.

line.nie_para.text: Those two don't go together. What do we use together?

line.nie_para.sarenka.text: Those two don't go together. What do we use together?

line.nie_para.kret.text: Those two don't go together. What do we use together?

line.b_pasuja.text: A brush and paints, a bee and a flower, a hammer and a nail!

line.b_drzwi.text: And I can't open my door. The storm mixed up my keys.

line.b_klucz.text: The door has a star-shaped keyhole. Which key fits it? Point to it.

line.b_klucz_nie.text: That key doesn't fit the keyhole. Look at its end.

line.b_otwarte.text: The star key fits the star door! It's open, thank you.

line.b_liscie.text: The last leaves of the storm are falling. Catch a leaf, point to it.

line.p_start.text: Let's play pairs! I have five games.

line.p_polacz.text: Join the things that go together with your finger.

line.p_polacz.sarenka.text: Join the things that go together with your finger.

line.p_pszczola.text: What goes with the bee? Point to it.

line.p_pszczola_nie.text: The bee doesn't need that. Where does the bee get its honey?

line.p_kwiatek.text: The flower! The bee sits on the flower.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find pairs: things that go together.

line.p_nie_pasuje.text: Which thing doesn't belong here? Point to it.

line.p_nie_pasuje_nie.text: The cup and the saucer are a pair. What doesn't go with them?

line.p_mlotek.text: The hammer! It goes with a nail, not with a cup.

line.d_przedpokoj.text: Things are mixed up in the hallway too. Join them into pairs.

line.d_porzadek.text: Every thing has its pair. All tidy!

line.d_rodzice.text: Play “what goes with what” with your parents: a spoon with soup, a toothbrush with toothpaste.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping after the storm! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Deer's star key. We got it when we looked for things that go together.
